svg.title: Allied Division of Germany and Four-Sector Berlin (Yalta & Potsdam, 1945)
svg.desc: Deterministic GIS historical atlas map showing the four Allied occupation zones of Germany in 1945 (British, American including Bremen enclave, French, and Soviet), Poland shifted west to the Oder-Neisse Line, a zoomed ALKIS Ortsteile GIS inset of Four-Sector Berlin deep inside the Soviet Zone, and the three Western Allied air corridors.

g.text: THREE WESTERN AIR CORRIDORS (100 MI INSIDE SBZ)

svg.text: EDEXCEL GCSE HISTORY • OPTION P4: ORIGINS OF THE COLD WAR
Allied Division of Germany & Four-Sector Berlin (Yalta & Potsdam, 1945)

g.text: Bavaria, Hesse, N. BW & Bremen port
